title: World Happiness Report 2026: social media and youth wellbeing
discussion_signal: The post interprets the report as showing stronger negative effects of intensive social-media use among young people, especially girls, alongside the protective role of social support, health, freedom, and institutional trust. It supports a platform-exit reading while also pointing to broader social conditions and possible redesign questions.
linked_research_question: When social media affects youth wellbeing, how do people weigh exit, safer use, social connection, and platform responsibility?
limits: The post does not establish causal effects of social media use
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative youth sample
